name: Verdant Bamboo Sea
description: Endless emerald stalks sway in a perfumed wind. Sunlight falls in green coins, and somewhere a flute is playing — though you cannot find the player. A mossy footpath wends north toward distant peaks; eastward you hear the rush of cold water.
first_visit_text: This is where your master left you. 'Cultivate well,' he said, 'and do not climb the peak until your qi has condensed.' Then he vanished into the bamboo, and only the flute remained.

name: The Old Hermit's Hut
description: A leaning hut of bamboo and patched silk. Smoke threads from the chimney though no one tends the fire. Inside, a kettle whistles softly; outside, a stone bench faces the sunrise. A small jade disc hangs from a red cord nailed to the doorpost — someone's forgotten charm.

name: River of Swords
description: A wide river the color of cold steel. Small whirlpools spin where currents cross, and rumor says blades of long-dead heroes still glint at the bottom. A wooden raft is moored to a willow.

name: Merchant's Crossing
description: A bustling market at the river's far bank. Stalls smell of dried fish, cinnabar paper, and frying oil. A cinnabar gate marks the road to greater cities.

name: Bandit Road
description: A neglected stone road cut into a hillside. Crows watch from broken statues, and the wind smells of old smoke. This stretch is infamous for the Black Banner cutpurses. Further east the road narrows and falls away between gray cliffs — locals will not name what lies beyond.

name: Azure Cloud Foothills
description: Mist hangs in white ribbons between pines. A worn pilgrim path climbs in switchbacks toward a peak so tall it disappears into cloud. Ahead, a stone gate carved with cranes marks the outer boundary of the Azure Cloud Sect.

name: Azure Cloud Outer Gate
description: Two crane-statues of pale jade stand guard before doors of carved cedar. Disciples in azure robes sweep the courtyard with quiet diligence. The air here hums with disciplined qi.

name: Azure Cloud Inner Courtyard
description: A wide courtyard of polished stone. Banners snap in the high wind. Stairways rise to the elders' pavilions; a small library nests under a curving roof.

name: Azure Cloud Library
description: A small high-roofed hall of cedarwood scrolls. A smell of old paper and pine resin. Lantern-light flickers across illuminated sutras. Three ranks of shelves: the open front, shoulder-high; the mid-shelves, behind a low rail and a single brass bell to summon the archivist; and — at the far west wall — a shelf closed by a wooden peg driven through the inner latch eight hundred years ago. A blue felt curtain hangs beside that shelf, worn to the colour of old sky. Behind it, a reading-room the architects did not draw.
first_visit_text: The librarian looks up from his catalogue, adjusts his spectacles without managing to make them sit straight, and produces a cup of tea before he produces a word. 'Quiet, please,' he says, almost kindly. 'The scrolls are sleeping.' A small bronze bell on the mid-shelf rail chimes once without being struck. He does not look at it.

name: Azure Cloud Forge
description: A low stone shed set apart from the main sect, built into the cliff so the forge-fire vents out into open air. The doorway glows orange even at noon. Rows of weapon-blanks, robe-stitchings and accessory-blanks hang from hooks along the rafters. A heavy anvil of black iron squats in the centre; a wooden bench along the wall bears a scarred leather apron, neatly folded, and a half-finished cup of tea.
first_visit_text: Heat washes out through the door. Inside, a forge-master looks up, squints, and grunts once in approval before going back to the bellows: 'Come in, close the door behind you. The fire minds drafts worse than I mind guests.'

name: Elder Baixu's Pavilion
description: An open pavilion at the cliff's edge, ringed by white pines. Wind chimes sing endlessly. Elder Baixu sits cross-legged, his eyes the color of frosted river stones.
